rooms.name: Main Lobby
rooms.notes: Main public entry lobby; large, well-lit, connects to reception and all ground-floor departments. Faces main street entrance per Vastu (east-facing preferred in Hyderabad site).

rooms.name: Reception & Registration
rooms.notes: Central reception desk with patient registration counters; must be visible from main lobby. IPHS/NBC Group C norm.

rooms.name: OPD Waiting Area
rooms.notes: Shared OPD waiting zone serving all consultation rooms; seating for ~40 persons per IPHS norms.

rooms.name: Consultation Room 1 — General Medicine
rooms.notes: OPD consultation; natural light required; NBC min 9.0 sqm, sized to 12 sqm for adequate doctor-patient clearance.

rooms.name: Consultation Room 3 — Orthopaedics
rooms.notes: Slightly larger to accommodate examination table and plaster trolley.

rooms.name: Consultation Room 4 — Gynaecology
rooms.notes: Includes examination alcove; privacy-sensitive placement away from main lobby sight-lines.

rooms.name: Pharmacy
rooms.notes: Retail pharmacy with dispensing counter and back-of-house cold-storage; directly accessible from lobby and OPD. IPHS/NBC Group C requirement.

rooms.name: Pathology / Diagnostic Laboratory
rooms.notes: Full pathology + biochemistry lab; MEP services (exhaust, biohazard drainage) required per NBC Part 9. Sized for 2 benches + equipment.

rooms.name: Sample Collection Room
rooms.notes: Phlebotomy / specimen collection; adjacent to lab for direct sample transfer.

rooms.name: Main OPD Corridor
rooms.notes: Double-loaded corridor min 2.4 m clear width per NBC Group C hospital norm; stretcher-passable.

rooms.name: Patient Toilet Block (Male)
rooms.notes: Accessible toilets per NBC Part 3 / IS 11942; minimum 3 WCs + 2 urinals; cross-infection prevention — not adjacent to pharmacy or lab.

rooms.name: Patient Toilet Block (Female)
rooms.notes: Accessible female toilets; located opposite male block on same corridor node; NBC Group C compliance.

rooms.name: Ground Floor Nursing Station / Help Desk
rooms.notes: Secondary nurse/help desk for OPD floor management; visual control of waiting area.

rooms.name: Housekeeping / Utility Store
rooms.notes: Soiled linen, housekeeping equipment; end-of-corridor location per infection-control zoning.

rooms.name: Staff Pantry
rooms.notes: Staff refreshment pantry; not adjacent to toilet blocks per NBC hygiene rules.

rooms.name: Main Staircase & Landing
rooms.notes: Fire-rated stairwell per NBC Part 4; min 1.5 m clear tread width for hospital; connects G to F1 and F2.

response.floor_summary: Ground floor houses the full outpatient department (OPD) — main public lobby, central reception, five multi-speciality consultation rooms, pharmacy, pathology laboratory with sample collection, accessible patient toilet blocks, nursing station, and support spaces — forming the primary public-access and diagnostic tier of the multi-speciality hospital.
